meaning:
λευκαίνω
(λευκός), [in LXX: Psa.51:7, Isa.1:18 (לָבַן hi.), etc. ;]
to whiten, make white: with accusative of thing(s), Mrk.9:3, Rev.7:14.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
